vehicle: 2000 Lexus GS300 / JZS160 / US / stock automatic
scope: Mechanical component identities, layout relationships and selected documented quantities. These references do not establish dimensionally accurate surfaces or a complete repair procedure.

sources.title: Lexus RM718U — 2JZ-GE cylinder head, EM-29–32 and EM-55 (manufacturer manual mirror)
sources.usedFor: Head covers, VVT-i oil supply, intake, coils, gasket and valve anatomy; source labels distinguish the GS300 engine from 1UZ sections.

sources.title: Lexus RM718U sample — EM-55 cylinder head assembly
sources.usedFor: Visual inspection of head-cover, intake manifold and injector-connector arrangement. No pages redistributed.

sources.title: 2000 GS300 timing belt — manufacturer procedure reproduced by Operation CHARM
sources.usedFor: Separate hydraulic tensioner/idler; No.1, 2, 3 and 4 covers; VVT-i oil-control hardware; 5/3/4 cover bolts and 2 hydraulic tensioner bolts. No torque or alignment simulator published.

sources.title: Lexus RM718U — 2JZ-GE water pump CO-5–9
sources.usedFor: Accessory-driven water-pump pulley, 4 retaining nuts, 6 pump bolts, gasket, block O-ring, bypass pipes, thermostat and drain hose.

sources.title: Lexus RM718U — GS300 timing-access and cooling components
sources.usedFor: Radiator, electric fan connections, ATF cooler hoses and intake components in the timing-access area.

sources.title: 2000 GS300 — A/T pan, strainer and temperature-sensor service
sources.usedFor: 19 pan bolts; 3 magnets; 4 strainer bolts; 3 strainer seals; 7 solenoid connectors; temperature sensor and harness. FIPG is specified, not an assumed pre-cut OEM pan gasket.

sources.title: Lexus RM718U — automatic transmission valve body AT-8
sources.usedFor: 21 valve-body retaining bolts and separate check-ball body/spring; positions and lengths not validated.

sources.usedFor: S1–S4, SLN, SLU and SLT identities and stacked valve-body sections. Not proof of 2000 port positions or calibration.

sources.title: Transtar 2011 Professional Automatic Transmission Parts Catalog — A650E pp.598–600
sources.fitment: A650E family; catalog distinguishes GS300 kit applications
sources.usedFor: Directly inspected exploded parts plate: bell, case, extension, clutch drums, friction/steel plates, planetary sets, front pump, strainer and pan. No exact internal stack count or calibrated hydraulic geometry claimed.

sources.title: Victory Motors — photographed 2000 GS300 engine bay
sources.fitment: 2000 GS300 US dealer listing; vehicle condition/stock status not independently certified
sources.usedFor: Intake crossover, right-side airbox and battery, compact forward cover, left-side brake reservoir. Dealer text incorrectly says V6; that text is rejected. Photo used as visual evidence only.

sources.title: Toyota / Lexus Technical Information System
sources.fitment: 2000 Lexus GS300 JZS160, US LHD, naturally aspirated 2JZ-GE VVT-i, stock automatic target
sources.usedFor: Primary acquisition route for configuration-specific repair manuals, electrical wiring diagrams, New Car Features and technical training. Select Lexus, 2000, GS300 and the 2JZ-GE sections; GS400 V8 sections do not apply. No paid access purchased. Do not mark unviewed manual pages as inspected.

sources.title: Lexus Parts Center Online
sources.fitment: 2000 Lexus GS300 JZS160, US LHD, naturally aspirated 2JZ-GE VVT-i, stock automatic target
sources.usedFor: Confirm component identities, assemblies, production applicability and supersessions against a privately held VIN or confirmed production date. Exploded parts drawings establish relationships, not surveyed dimensions. No exact OEM part numbers newly assigned.

sources.title: Lexus GS300 factory VVT-i cutaway photograph (1997–2000)
sources.fitment: 2000 Lexus GS300 JZS160, US LHD, naturally aspirated 2JZ-GE VVT-i, stock automatic target
sources.usedFor: Compact forward cover and VVT-i mechanism orientation. Confirms that a display cutaway removes portions of protective shells; it is not the appearance of an intact engine. UK archive, engine-family reference only. Not evidence for US installation coordinates, hidden passages or tolerances. Source image is linked, not redistributed.

sources.title: Lexus RM718U excerpt: EC-4 PCV system and EM-55 cylinder head
sources.kind: Manufacturer manual on a third-party mirror
sources.fitment: 2000 Lexus GS300 JZS160, US LHD, naturally aspirated 2JZ-GE VVT-i, stock automatic target
sources.usedFor: PCV elbow/seat and hose connection; separate head covers and manifold; existing four appearance-cover nuts corroborated. Source header explicitly identifies 2000 GS300/GS400 and the relevant 2JZ-GE sections. Excerpt is incomplete. Modeled valve port sizes, spring/flow behavior, hose routing and all installation measurements remain unverified. No repair instructions or page images copied into the site.

sources.title: Lexus second-generation GS300 launch technical specification
sources.fitment: 2000 Lexus GS300 JZS160, US LHD, naturally aspirated 2JZ-GE VVT-i, stock automatic target
sources.usedFor: Engine-family identity: inline six, DOHC 24 valves, 2997 cc, nominal 86 mm bore and 86 mm stroke. UK launch specification, not a US 2000 parts-fit record. Bore/stroke do not determine casting shape, bore spacing or piston clearance.

rejectedSources.reason: PDF identifies 1997 Supra RM502U and distributor ignition. Not the GS300 VVT-i reference.
